main.description: Remove one track from a playlist. Deletes the app.rocksky.playlist.song record that put it there, which only the repo that added it can do. Prefer `index`: a song can sit in a playlist more than once, and `songUri` alone cannot say which copy to drop.

uri.description: The URI of the playlist to remove the track from

songUri.description: The URI of the app.rocksky.song record to remove. Removes every copy of it; pass `index` instead to remove one.

index.description: 0-based position of the entry to remove, in the order getPlaylist returns.
